title.narrative: Supporting Rwanda for Malaria Control - Rwanda (01-Jan-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Rwanda, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Rwanda (Ministry of health)This program has the following goals: To reduce malaria mortality by 30% of 2015-2016 level by 2020. The objectives of this program are: By 2020, at least 90% of population at risk will be effectively protected with locally appropriate preventative and vector control interventions. By 2020, all malaria cases will be promptly treated in line with national guidelines. By 2020, all health facilities will provide complete reporting so as to strengthen surveillance, monitoring and evaluation, and inform operational research. By 2020, effective program management and coordination will be expanded to all levels including multi-sectorial and regional partnerships. By 2020, 75% of the population will have correct knowledge, behaviours and practices towards malaria prevention and control
